person.name: Shahrzad Behzadi
person.text: Listed in Streak as **Executive Producer, Restoration & Remastering** at MTI Film. MTI's restoration page credits her as **restoration artist** on about 14 titles (including *The Pink Panther*, *Topkapi*, *Sunset Blvd.*, *Seinfeld*, *Married with Children*, *Richard Pryor – Live on Sunset Strip* and several silent films) and as **producer** on *Designing Women*, *Walker Texas Ranger* and *Beverly Hills 90210* remasters. Her education, tenure and earlier roles are **to be confirmed** (no public bio found).

company.text: MTI Film is a Hollywood post-production and technology company. It offers dailies, offline editorial, VFX and final colour grading, the **MTI Remote Center**, film restoration (scanning up to 8K, clean-up, frame generation, colour) and software: **DRS™Nova** (Emmy-winning restoration software), **Cortex** and **MTai** AI tools (FrameGen, Frame Convert). Notable restorations: *Lawrence of Arabia*, *Taxi Driver*, *The Godfather Part II*, *The Bridge on the River Kwai*, *Sunset Blvd.*; MTI Remote supported *Shōgun* and *9-1-1*. In **June 2026** MTI acquired **Mango New Edit** (remote dailies and Avid editorial, founded 1994 by Stan Cassio, who stays on as **SVP Post Production Sales**). **Larry Chernoff** is named as the company's leader (exact title to be confirmed).

financials.text: Private company: no financial figures published. The **Mango New Edit acquisition (June 2026)** shows MTI is investing to grow its on-set-to-screen post services. No public ESG or sustainability statement was found on its website.
